title: Chapter 189 Undead Guard
content:
Chapter 189 Undead Guard

Wang Shuo took dozens of his men and set off toward the passage on the left in a mighty manner.

After taking a few steps, several more underworld beasts appeared.

Of course, this underworld beast did not cause any obstacles to everyone.

The passage was like a maze, and Wang Shuo took out the map of the Dragon King's underground palace, which was the treasure map that Wang Shuo had worked so hard to obtain.

On the map, the main hall is marked, showing Wang Shuo's current location.

Inside the main hall, there are several rooms, some of which are marked with names.

The area outside the main hall is temporarily gray.

It seems that you need to leave the main hall to display other areas.

Wang Shuo thought for a while and decided to explore the main hall first.

Not long after walking, we came to the door of a huge room. This room was called "Military Aircraft Department" on the map.

The two armored soldiers with black aura guarding the door immediately attacked them.

【Undead Guard Soldier】

[Level: Level 32]

[Attack power: 260]

[Defense: 100]

[Health value: 5000]

There is no flesh and blood in the helmets of these two soldiers, only some white nose bones can be seen.

"Get ready to fight." Wang Shuo immediately ordered.

The level of the guardsmen is higher than that of the underworld beasts, but their attack power and health are lower.

However, the way humanoid monsters fight is completely different from the way beasts fight, so you can't just look at their attributes.

I saw the undead guard holding a big sword in his hand and running towards Wang Shuo and others quickly.

Wang Shuo stepped forward and immediately attacked with his flaming spear. With a powerful and heavy blow, he suddenly hit the undead guard's shoulder.

The spear head hit the armor and caused sparks, which made Wang Shuo's arm numb, but only caused a few dozen points of damage.

It’s not easy to deal with!

Gong Zheng also stepped forward and resisted the opponent's attack with his shield.

Due to the narrow terrain, although the soldiers led by Wang Shuo were large in number, they were unable to exert their advantage.

Thanks to several cutting-edge combat forces with good strength, they still have an overwhelming advantage against the two undead guards.

Wang Shuo found the right moment, stabbed the spear directly into the armor, and directly activated the "Fire Breath" skill.

In an instant, it caused 300 points of damage to the Undead Guard.

The spear was in the armor, strangled, and a series of injuries appeared above the head of the undead guard.

Everyone worked together to attack, and after a while, the armor could no longer maintain its human shape and was scattered into scraps of metal on the ground.

Wang Shuo picked up a few energy crystals and turned around to attack another undead guard. After a while, the battle ended.

Pushing open the door, I saw a thin gray-robed skeleton leaning over a desk, pretending to be examining a memorial in front of me.

"Bold, who dares to break into the military aircraft?"

The skeleton turned its head and roared. The two skeleton soldiers behind him, holding sharp swords, immediately attacked Wang Shuo and others.

Nothing to say, just do it.

The combat power of these two skeleton soldiers was slightly higher than that of the soldiers guarding the gate, but they could not cause any harm to Wang Shuo and others.

Three times, five times and two times, it was beaten into a pile of broken bones.

It's just a pity that they have armor on them.

When it was worn on them, the light shone brightly, but after being killed, it turned into scrap metal.

Now, all that's left is the skeleton that looks like a civil servant.

[Undead Book Official (Xu Wen) ID: Long DW6521478, Silver Boss]

[Level: Level 40]

[Attack power: 100]

[Defense: 80]

[Health value: 4000]

[Skills: Knowing everything clearly, three people become a tiger, and they are upright and awe-inspiring. 】

[Remarks: Xu Wen was once the records officer of the Lord's Mansion of Black Dragon City. He was also responsible for sorting out reports submitted from various places. He was the highest official of the Government Order Center. 】

Seeing that the opponent was actually a humanoid silver boss, Wang Shuo was on high alert.
